dialogues.speaker: Brovinov
dialogues.text: Ones about research into mechanical devices and the like, of course... Hehe. They even published the reader's letter I wrote to them last time...

dialogues.speaker: Brovinov
dialogues.text: Ah, if only I had enough Mora... I'd be able to buy that issue.

dialogues.speaker: Brovinov
dialogues.text: But there are always more important things to spend Mora on... aren't there?
